observations.title: Fuego volcano (Guatemala)
observations.description: The Instituto Nacional de Sismología, Vulcanologia, Meteorologia e Hidrología (INSIVUMEH) reported that eruptive activity at Fuego continued during 6-14 October. Daily explosions recorded by the seismic network, at rates of 2-8 per hour, generated gas-and-ash plumes that rose as high as 1.1 km above the summit and mainly drifted as far as 40 km in various directions. Shock waves and rumbling sounds from explosions were reported almost daily. Explosions also often ejected incandescent material, sometimes as high as 300 m above the summit, and onto the flanks causing incandescent block avalanches; notable avalanches descended the Seca (W), Taniluyá (SSW), Ceniza (SSW), Honda, and Las Lajas (SE) drainages, sometimes reaching vegetated areas. On 7 October lahars descended the Mineral and Seca drainages, carrying tree branches, trunks, and blocks as large as 3 m in diameter. Ashfall was reported in El Porvenir (11 km SW), El Rodeo (10 km SSE), La Reina, La Reunión (7 km SE), and surrounding areas during 6-7 October, in Yepocapa (8 km NW) and nearby areas during 10-11 October, and in Panimaché II (8 km SW), Yepocapa, and surrounding areas during 13-14 October. Source: Instituto Nacional de Sismologia, Vulcanologia, Meteorologia, e Hidrologia (INSIVUMEH)
